scope: tracked built-in catalog; excludes user database and production overlays

operators.name: ChunkGatedDeltaRule
operators.description: Chunked Gated Delta Rule（chunk 版门控 Delta 规则，线性注意力的 prefill 形态）：按 chunk 切块并行地递推状态 S_t = α_t·S_{t-1} + β_t·(v_t − α_t·S_{t-1}k_t)k_t^T，并输出 o_t = S_t·(q_t·scale)。真机 op_def：ops-transformer/attention/chunk_gated_delta_rule/op_host/chunk_gated_delta_rule_def.cpp（query/key/value/beta/initial_state/actual_seq_lengths 全 REQUIRED，g 是 OPTIONAL 输入、scale_value 是 OPTIONAL 属性，按仓规落实现类不进资产）。张量名序与 op_def 声明序逐位一致（query key value beta initial_state actual_seq_lengths → out final_state；OPTIONAL 的 g 声明在 actual_seq_lengths 之后，被跳过不影响必填位逐位对齐）。真机内核 KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_2（cube 打 3 组 V×K 矩阵乘、vector/SFU 做 g 的累积与状态逐元素缩放），故 compute_unit 取 mix。形状按真机 aclnn 表取：query/key (T, Nk, Dk)、value (T, Nv, Dv)、beta (T, Nv)、initial_state (B, Nv, Dv, Dk)、actual_seq_lengths (B,)，输出 out (T, Nv, Dv)、final_state (B, Nv, Dv, Dk)。T 是打包后的扁平 token 轴（无 batch 分维），建模侧写 B * S。compute_flops 取每 token 每 value head 的 3 组 Dv×Dk 矩阵乘（v−α·Sk、⊗k 外积更新、S·q），与同算法的建模层算子 GatedDeltaNet 同口径（其表达式为 6 * B * S * linear_num_value_heads * linear_key_head_dim * linear_value_head_dim）；chunk 内的 q·k^T 与 attn·v 两组块内矩阵乘不计入，两侧一致。

operators.name: FlashAttentionScore
operators.description: FlashAttention score computation: softmax(QK^T * scale + mask) @ V with on-line softmax, BNSD layout; real_shift, drop_mask, padding_mask, atten_mask and the actual-seq/scale/rope inputs are all optional and live in the implementation class (aclnnFlashAttentionScore)

operators.name: FusedInferAttentionScore
operators.description: Fused inference attention (aclnnFusedInferAttentionScore V4): softmax(QK^T * scale) @ V, BNSD layout. The 31 inputs are declared in op_def order; key/value/several scale inputs are DYNAMIC rather than OPTIONAL, so the naming rule requires every one of them to be registered here. Attributes: num_heads=1, scale=1.0, pre_tokens/next_tokens=2147483647, input_layout="BSH", num_key_value_heads=0, sparse_mode=0, inner_precise=1, block_size=0, antiquant_mode=0, softmax_lse_flag=false, out_dtype=0 (ops-transformer/attention/fused_infer_attention_score/op_host/fused_infer_attention_score_def.cpp)

operators.name: KvQuantSparseFlashAttention

operators.name: SparseFlashAttention
operators.description: Sparse flash attention: fused attention over index-selected KV positions (aclnnSparseFlashAttention)

operators.name: AddRmsNorm
operators.description: Residual add fused with RMS normalization: y = rmsnorm(x1 + x2), rstd is the reciprocal standard deviation and the pre-norm residual (aclnnAddRmsNorm)

operators.name: AddRmsNormBias
operators.description: Residual add fused with biased RMS normalization: y = rmsnorm(x1 + x2, gamma, beta), rstd is the reciprocal standard deviation and x the pre-norm residual sum (aclnnAddRmsNormBias)

operators.name: Cast
operators.description: Element-wise dtype conversion; the output dtype is chosen by the required dst_type attribute, so the asset models the bf16 -> fp32 path (aclnnCast)

operators.name: CausalConv1d
operators.description: Causal depthwise 1-D convolution over the sequence axis with in-place conv-state update: y takes x's shape, conv_states output takes conv_states input's shape (same name declared as both input and output in the op_def). attrs: activation_mode default "silu", null_block_id default 0 (ops-transformer/mamba/causal_conv1d/op_host/causal_conv1d_def.cpp)

operators.name: Cumsum
operators.description: Prefix sum over the token axis for low-latency MoE routing metadata (aclnnCumsum)

operators.name: DynamicMxQuant
operators.description: Dynamic block-MX quantization of activations: per-64-element E8M0 scale and FP8 result (aclnnDynamicMxQuant)

operators.name: DynamicQuantV2
operators.description: Dynamic per-token quantization to INT8 with a smoothing factor (aclnnDynamicQuantV2); smooth_scales and group_index are optional and live in the implementation class

operators.name: FusedGdnGating
operators.description: GDN (Gated Delta Network) 融合门控：一次 kernel 出两路——g = -exp(a_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias)，beta_output = sigmoid(b)。softplus 取 (1/beta)*ln(1+exp(beta*(a+dt_bias)))，当 beta*(a+dt_bias) > threshold 时退线性近似防溢出。真机 op_def：ops-transformer/experimental/attention/fused_gdn_gating/op_host/fused_gdn_gating_def.cpp（a_log/a/b/dt_bias 全 REQUIRED，g/beta_output 全 REQUIRED，beta/threshold 是 OPTIONAL 属性、落实现类）。张量名序与 op_def 声明序逐位一致（校验器按序比，错了直接判违规）；校准侧要的 numel 是主数据路 a 的逐元素数，而族级 elementwise 取形固定读 inputs[0]、这里却是常量 a_log，故由算子类用 `calibration_semantics` 显式指到 a（见 `layers/elementwise/fused_gdn_gating.py`）。族目录按语义域取 elementwise（纯向量，无 cube 通道），与真机 op_def 所在的 attention 目录是两回事。profiling 实测：input '48;8192,48;8192,48;48'（a/b 各 48 个长 8192 的 run，a_log/dt_bias 各 48 个标量），output '1,8192,48;1,8192,48'，故主数据路为扁平 [B * S, num_heads] 且 a/b 与 a_log/dt_bias 数量相等（每 head 一项）。g 真机固定 FLOAT32，beta_output 与 b 同 dtype。

operators.name: GatherV2
operators.description: Indexed row gather from a table; the real-machine kernel behind token embedding lookup (aclnnGatherV2)

operators.name: GemmaRmsNorm
operators.description: Gemma-style RMS normalization with offset scale y = x * rstd * (1 + gamma); same kernel as RmsNorm (gemma_rms_norm_apt.cpp includes rms_norm/arch35/rms_norm_regbase_perf.h with IS_GEMMA=true), whose only extra work is one Adds(gamma, 1.0f) per element -> 7 vector ops and no SFU; profiled at [8192, 5120] + [5120] -> [8192, 5120] + [8192, 1]

operators.name: LayerNormV4

operators.name: Mul
operators.description: Element-wise multiply y = x1 * x2 with numpy-style broadcasting; no attributes (ops-math/math/mul/op_host/mul_def.cpp)

operators.name: RmsNorm
operators.description: Root mean square normalization with per-channel gamma (aclnnRmsNorm); rstd is a required output. A5 regbase kernel counts 6 vector ops per element and no SFU (arch35: Mul square, fold/head Add tree, Mul(rstd), Mul(gamma); rstd comes from Adds(eps)/Div/Sqrt/Newton-Raphson, all inside __VEC_SCOPE__)

operators.name: ScatterNdUpdate

operators.name: Sigmoid

operators.name: SwiGlu

operators.name: SwigluGroupQuant

operators.name: Transpose

operators.name: GroupedMatmul

operators.name: GroupedMatmulSwigluQuantV2
